symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() read only w:t, w:tab, w:br/w:cr and w:noBreakHyphen, so it dropped every Word <w:sym> character, and it kept Symbol-font text typed as private-use code points (U+F0xx), which display as empty boxes. This compilation has eight minute signs typed in the Symbol font as U+F0A2, all in the latitudes and longitudes of paragraph 5 (Seal Reserves) of the Annex to the Convention for the Conservation of Antarctic Seals (Schedule 1). cth_convert_sym_v2.py maps Symbol-font characters to their Unicode characters (· × − • ≤ ≥ ° ′ ″ — ÷ ± and + = < > ≡), Wingdings boxes to "[ ]", and private-use code points U+F0xx the same way; no Wingdings box or w:sym element occurs here.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: 2 lines, nothing else: line 981, paragraph 5(a), "60° 20′ and 60° 56′ South Latitude and 44° 05′ and 46° 25′ West Longitude" (the four minute signs were U+F0A2); line 983, paragraph 5(c), "72° 19′ South Latitude, 170° 18′ East Longitude, and Helm Point, at 72° 11′ South Latitude, 170° 00′ East Longitude" (likewise). Line numbers and character count are unchanged.
